apps.name: Git + GitHub CLI
apps.description: Installs git and the GitHub CLI (gh) into the workspace, survives restarts, and provides a settings panel for gh login (token stored in the zero-knowledge secret store).

apps.name: AWS CLI
apps.description: Installs the AWS CLI v2 into the workspace and provides a settings panel for AWS credentials (access key, secret key, region, session token — applied via `aws configure`, secret fields routed to the zero-knowledge secret store).

apps.name: Essential CLI Tools
apps.description: Installs a set of essential CLI tools into the workspace (telnet, ping, curl, nc, perl, python, vim, docker) and keeps them present across restarts. No login/settings/secrets — pure command install.

apps.name: AW Proxy
apps.description: Browser cookie proxy: the HTTP CONNECT proxy the AW Browser tunnels through, the /sync-cookies + /clear-cookies API the aw-sync browser extensions (Chrome + iOS/Safari, downloadable from the app's window) push cookies through, and encrypted persistence of chosen cookies in Postgres so they survive a proxy restart. aw-app-browser depends on this app for authentication.

apps.name: AW Browser
apps.description: Headless Chromium as a Tier-2 (container) app — a prebuilt ghcr.io/browserless/chromium image spawned by the workspace over the rootless podman socket, run with --shm-size=1g, its CDP endpoint reverse-proxied at /api/apps/browser/* (ws://.../json/version, driveable by Playwright/CDP clients). First real Tier-2 app; supersedes the fragile Tier-1 in-process prototype.

apps.name: Presentations
apps.description: HTML presentations created by agents (diffs, reports, dashboards) — top-bar gallery nav + a window that renders each presentation. Replaces the monolith's /ws/presentations feature and the aw-frontend static PresentationNav.

apps.name: Whiteboard
apps.description: Persistent, live-synced HTML canvas — set/patch content, broadcast changes over a WebSocket to every open viewer, round-trip with a presentation. Migrated from the aw monolith (src/api/routes/whiteboard.py + whiteboard_manager.py + WhiteboardWindow.jsx).

apps.name: MCP Gateway
apps.description: Federated MCP gateway as a Tier-2 (container) app — exposes stdio MCP servers over Streamable HTTP + a /link WebSocket for gateway-to-gateway federation (flat namespace first-wins, per-peer tokens, federation-depth limit). ADDITIVE: coexists with the monolith's in-repo src/mcp/gateway.py (profiles + /lazy), which it will eventually strangle once it reaches parity. Installed by default via the normal install flow (signed=true) like the other bootstrap apps.
